explanation: Connects actual prime selection to the retained original color-class witnesses. The selected modulus and all stored prefix data are tied to the same strictly sorted representatives of the original color classes.
theorem_title: Prime selection from retained normalized original arrays
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.program_meets {av ae bv be cv ce tables rec vals g M y free maxMod U : ℕ} {hg : 0 < g}
    {originalA originalB originalC A B C : List ℤ}
    {hsA : A.Pairwise (· < ·)} {hsB : B.Pairwise (· < ·)} {hsC : C.Pairwise (· < ·)} {rA : ℤ}
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ) ≤ lim.word) (hy : 0 < y)
    (hav : av+A.length ≤ free) (hbv : bv+B.length ≤ free) (hcv : cv+C.length ≤ free)
    (hae : ae+2 ≤ free) (hbe : be+2 ≤ free) (hce : ce+2 ≤ free)
    (hrec : rec+4*_root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.count A.length B.length C.length g ≤ free)
    (hspace : _root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrimeCore.space free maxMod g M y U ≤ lim.space)
    (hword : (_root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.word maxMod A.length B.length C.length g M y U : ℤ) ≤ lim.word)
    (hd : d+Nat.clog 2 maxMod+10 ≤ lim.depth)
    (hA : ∀ z ∈ originalA, |z| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ originalB, |z| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ originalC, |z| ≤ (U : ℤ))
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceFiniteData.Normalized μ av ae bv be cv ce tables rec vals g hg
      originalA originalB originalC A B C hsA hsB hsC rA)
    (hmax : (4*y)^(_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeDepth.depth M y+1) ≤ maxMod) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.program 24 d [av,ae,bv,be,cv,ce,g,rec,M,y,free] μ
      (_root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.time maxMod A.length B.length C.length g M y U)
      (fun result ν =>
        result=(_root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.moduli A B C g hg hsA hsB hsC y (_root_.ThreeSum.LightBandPrimeDepth.depth M y) : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.EncodedColorPrimeData.Stored ν free M y (_root_.ThreeSum.LightEncodedColorPrime.moduli A B C g hg hsA hsB hsC y) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν free) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let original integer class lists be bounded by $U$ and represented by strictly normalized lists $A,B,C$ with positive band width $g$. Let $y>0$ be the prime-window control. Suppose normalized values and headers and the exact owner records precede the free address, $(4y)^{d(M,y)+1}$ fits the maximum modulus, and the stated construction space, word, address, and depth bounds hold. The closed program reads the retained lengths, returns the exact selected common modulus for these same normalized lists, stores the full prescribed modulus data, and preserves the preceding memory within its stated time.

Connects actual prime selection to the retained original color-class witnesses. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
